Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra


The Covens of Umbra Challenge League

  • Upon disrupting the coven's magicks, you will get to select a Fate for the boss of the area you're in.

Return to top

Endgame Changes

  • Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.
  • Below are the new Thread items available:
    • Abyss Thread
    • Incursion Thread
  • Added a new Currency Item, Frayed Thread which can be used to grant a random Thread.

Return to top

League Changes


Incursion and Atziri
  • The Temple of Atzoatl now has fewer rooms & more architects.

Return to top

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where the Lighting Rods in the Temple of Atzoatl were very loud.

We really hope you enjoy Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra. Thanks for your support!
